={
  "model": "Qwen3.6-35B-Hauhau",
  "temperature": 0.3,
  "max_tokens": 6000,
  "response_format": {"type": "json_object"},
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "你是小红书商业情报解析器。从输入的 md 周报里提取结构化数据。

**类目 taxonomy 严格锁死为以下 8 类** (报告里的其他分类映射进这 8 类, 不许新造):
- 美妆个护
- 家居家装
- 母婴育儿
- 服饰穿搭
- 食品饮料
- 萌宠动物
- 3C数码
- 旅游户外

**严格返回 JSON**:
{
  "report_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "categories_meta": [{"name":"美妆个护","tier":1,"insight":"一句话概括本类目本周态势, 从报告里摘"}, ...],
  "creators": [{"name":"程十安","category":"美妆个护","tier":"top","homepage":"...","followers":"2400万+","tagline":"..."}, ...],
  "hot_notes": [{"creator":"程十安","category":"美妆个护","title":"肿泡眼化妆教程系列","metrics":{"likes":null,"collects":null,"followers_gained":null,"monetization_cny":500000},"metrics_raw":"单条广告报价50万","note":"..."}, ...],
  "trends": ["趋势1一句话", "趋势2"]
}

只保留 hot_notes.metrics 里能明确从报告里提取到的数字, 无法提取则 null. metrics_raw 保留原文描述。tier 值 top/mid/腰部/尾部。"
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "请解析下面的 md 周报:

{{ JSON.stringify($json.md_content).slice(1,-1) }}"
    }
  ]
}

={
  "chat_id": "{{ $('Extract Params').item.json.tg_chat_id }}",
  "text": {{ JSON.stringify('✅ Kimi 周报导入完成
